verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents a resource-oriented REST API with a full embedded OpenAPI 3.0 spec and a dated versioning policy, which supports scripted access to account objects and pushing raw data via API endpoints. Its MCP docs explicitly describe a setup path for environments with no browser, such as CI jobs and scripts, so non-interactive automation is a documented use case. Missing for 10: complete documentation of the headless/CI auth flow (the snippet is truncated), any official CLI or CI-pipeline integration (e.g., a CI action or plugin), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
